brand_voice.motto: Gravity keeps us grounded — AI built ANTIGRAVITY to lift us up.
brand_voice.tone: Mission-forward, warm toward AI partners, kids-first, anti-drift

layout.structure: Grid layout. Left rail navigation (SidebarRail), main work area, fixed MissionTicker (bottom).
layout.spacing_scale: Generous. p-4, p-8, p-12. Large gaps for breathing room.
layout.border_radius: Sharp edges with subtle roundness on inner cards. max rounded-md (6px) or rounded-none for brutalist feel.

motion.heartbeat: pulse on active agent cards (slow 2s) with scale and opacity changes
motion.effects: grain overlay on background, focus ring glow on command palette

SidebarRail.description: Left rail navigation, icon + label collapsed/expanded.
SidebarRail.styles: bg-[#1A1614] border-r border-[#261F1C] h-screen transition-all duration-300
SidebarRail.interaction: Hover expands rail or shows tooltip if collapsed.

MissionTicker.styles: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-[#FF6B35] text-[#141110] font-data font-bold py-2 px-4 flex justify-between items-center z-50 shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgba(255,107,53,0.3)]

ProviderChip.description: Shows which AI provider is active.
ProviderChip.styles: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 bg-[#261F1C] border border-[#B5A79E]/20 text-xs font-label text-[#F9F6EE] rounded-sm uppercase tracking-wider

ModelSelector.description: Dropdown to select multi-provider AI model (6 providers).
ModelSelector.styles: bg-[#1A1614] border border-[#261F1C] text-[#F9F6EE] font-label text-sm px-3 py-2 hover:border-[#FF6B35] transition-colors focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF6B35]

ChatBubble.description: Chat interface for User vs Assistant.
ChatBubble.user_styles: bg-[#261F1C] text-[#F9F6EE] font-data p-4 rounded-tl-md rounded-tr-md rounded-bl-md ml-auto max-w-[80%]
ChatBubble.assistant_styles: bg-[#141110] border border-[#261F1C] text-[#F9F6EE] font-data p-4 rounded-tr-md rounded-br-md rounded-bl-md mr-auto max-w-[80%]
ChatBubble.footer: text-[10px] font-label text-[#8A7D75] mt-2 flex gap-2 border-t border-[#261F1C] pt-2

AgentCard.description: Status board card for agent fleet (CEO/CFO/CMO/CTO/INTERN).
AgentCard.styles: bg-[#1A1614] border border-[#261F1C] p-4 flex flex-col gap-3 relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-[#FF6B35]/50 transition-colors

elements.tier_badge: absolute top-4 right-4 text-[10px] font-label border border-[#8A7D75]/30 px-2 py-0.5 text-[#B5A79E] rounded-sm
elements.heartbeat_dot: Heartbeat pulse animation. Green/Amber depending on status.
elements.task_bar: w-full bg-[#141110] h-1.5 mt-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden (task count bar out of 25)

TokenCard.styles: bg-[#1A1614] border border-[#261F1C] p-5 flex flex-col gap-4

elements.title: font-heading text-2xl text-[Token Color]
elements.supply_bar: h-2 w-full bg-[#141110] relative rounded-full overflow-hidden (cap 2.5M)
elements.breakdown: text-xs font-label flex justify-between text-[#8A7D75] mt-2

BucketCell.styles: aspect-square border border-[#261F1C] bg-[#141110] p-3 flex flex-col justify-between hover:bg-[#1A1614] transition-colors relative

KeyHint.styles: inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-[#261F1C] border border-[#8A7D75]/30 text-[#B5A79E] font-label text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm min-w-[20px]

CommandPalette.styles: fixed inset-0 bg-[#141110]/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4
CommandPalette.modal_content: bg-[#1A1614] border border-[#261F1C] w-full max-w-2xl rounded-md shadow-2xl overflow-hidden focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-[#FF6B35] focus-within:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,107,53,0.15)]
CommandPalette.input: w-full bg-transparent border-b border-[#261F1C] text-[#F9F6EE] font-data p-4 outline-none placeholder:text-[#8A7D75]

images.description: Warm orbit space planet for subtle textures/hero sections
Silhouette of man/child with plant during sunset - hopeful imagery

icons.style: Duotone weight for warmth, or regular for clean tech look

global_rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Overlay noise/grain on the background to enhance the physical/analog ops feel.
Browser notifications should trigger for agent fleet events.
instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI as base.
Install specified fonts: Instrument Serif, JetBrains Mono, Geist Mono.
Set up layout with SidebarRail on left and MissionTicker fixed at bottom.
Implement Command Palette with Framer Motion for staggered mount and smooth entry.
Build out AgentCard grid showing CEO/CFO/CMO/CTO/INTERN statuses with heartbeats.
Ensure all tokenomics charts/supply bars use DAO specific colors defined in tokens palette.
Implement the 10-bucket revenue engine using the BucketCell component specs.
